research.title: Three.js Ships WebGPU by Default Now. Here Is What the Migration Actually Breaks
research.whyTrending: WebGPU hit baseline in every major browser; Three.js r171+ ships a production WebGPU renderer with ~95% coverage and automatic WebGL2 fallback for the rest. 30-50% gains on dense scenes. The blog has 182 articles and zero on 3D or graphics despite three.js being a project dependency.

content.finalTitle: Three.js on WebGPU: The One-Line Migration That Isn't
